description: Canonical signed envelopes for the Master-side Step 89 writes: consented lake intake, collaboration room creation, distillation scheduling and package-index publication. The signature proves provenance; it grants no capability and the envelope never executes itself.

envelope.signature: Ed25519 over canonical JSON of signed_fields. It records who asked; it grants nothing.

lake-intake.rule: consent must be true; the store is training/backup evidence, never a knowledge answer.

collab-room.rule: The room is ABAC-bounded; creation never writes a message or a shared corpus.

distill-schedule.rule: Scheduling records intent only; training still requires the operator-triggered distill run.

package-index.rule: The index is signed package data; a peer still installs it only by explicit action.

rules: Every write requires --confirm and a signature that verifies before apply.
The signature is provenance, not authority; it cannot grant, revoke or widen a capability.
A lake record without consent is refused.
A package index never installs or executes itself.
An action record is stored under the Master state dir; it is not a peer knowledge channel.
